 Appearance:
 Shri Anil Kumar Mishra with Shri Ashish Singh Jadoun - Ad
 applicant.
Shri Yogesh Parashar - Pp for the respondents/State.

Order 
1
.  This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of BNSS, 2023 for grant of regular bail.

3. The applicant has been arrested on 20.12.2024 in connection with Crime No.716/2023 registered at Police Station Cantt., District Guna for offence under Sections 420, 467, 468, 120-B, 471, 201 of IPC.
4. Prosecution story, in short, is that the present applicant on the pretext of allotment of government land obtained about Rs.11 Lac and photocopies of aadhar cards from 21 victim persons.
Allegation levelled against present applicant is that she told co-accused persons for measurement of land and and commit fraud.
The applicant along with other co-accused persons is accused of defrauding the complainant along with other similar innocent persons.

The complainant lodged a complaint at P.S.
Cantt. Guna.
During investigation, statements of complainant and other witnesses were recorded and the fake documents were NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:10297 2 MCRC-18962-2025 seized.
Accordingly, offence has been registered against the present applicant.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant contended that the applicant is innocent and she has been falsely implicated in this matter.
Applicant is in custody since 20.12.2024.

Only omnibus allegations Pooja Sharma vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/98070319/
1 have been levelled against her without any substantial documentary evidence.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Nothing has been recovered from the possession of the applicant.
She is a 33 years old lady and also she is a practicing lawyer having two minor children.

Co-accused persons namely, Brijnath Kushwah and Sachin Kumar Dandi have already been enlarged on by bail by this Court order dated 04.04.2025 passed in M.Cr.C. No.14082/2025 and order dated 22.04.2025 passed in M.Cr.C. No.17427/2025,
respectively.
Applicant is ready to deposit the alleged amount.
Investigation is over and charge-sheet has been filed.
Applicant is permanent resident of District Guna and there is no likelihood of her absconsion.
Final conclusion of trial will take a considerable long time.
Hence, he prays that applicant may be released on bail.

6 . Per contra , learned Public Prosecutor for respondent/State opposes the bail application and prays for its rejection by submitting that the present applicant is the main accused in this case, but he fairly submitted that applicant is not having any criminal history.
7. Both the parties heard and perused the case diary.

8. Considering all the facts and circumstances of the case, arguments advanced by counsel for the parties, also taking note of the fact that certain allegation regarding aforesaid fraud has been levelled against present applicant but no document has been recovered from the possession of the applicant,
applicant is NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:10297 3 MCRC-18962-2025 a practicing Advocate and lady having two minor children, investigation is over and charge-sheet has been filed and also applicant is ready deposit the alleged amount; two other co-accused persons have already been enlarged on bail and final conclusion of trial will take considerable long time, therefore, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.
9. Accordingly, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is directed that that the applicant shall deposit the amount of Rs.11 Lacs (Rupees Eleven Lacs Only)
before the concerned trial court within 15 days from the date of this order and on depositing the aforesaid amount the applicant be released on bail upon her furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for her appearance before the trial Court, as and when required.

She shall abide by the conditions enumerated u/S. 437(3) Cr.P.C/480(3) of BNSS.
C.C. as per rules.

(ANIL VERMA) JUDGE Vishal Pooja Sharma vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/98070319/
